records.public_claim_text: OpenAI reports collecting feedback on real use cases from nearly 200 early-access partners before releasing GPT-5.5.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: We subjected the model to our full suite of predeployment safety evaluations and our Preparedness Framework, including targeted red-teaming for advanced cybersecurity and biology capabilities, and collected feedback on real use cases from nearly 200 early-access partners before release.

records.public_claim_text: OpenAI says it generally treats GPT-5.5 safety results as strong proxies for GPT-5.5 Pro because both use the same underlying model.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: We generally treat GPT-5.5’s safety results as strong proxies for GPT-5.5 Pro, which is the same underlying model using a setting that makes use of parallel test time compute.
